decisions: Impl declarations are retained independently of method lists; no synthetic placeholder function is introduced.
All program-merge/test-harness paths retain implementation declarations.
Concrete trait implementation and associated bindings have one semantic catalog, shared by method binding and generic constraints. Existing method checks remain.
Methodless declarations validate unknown traits, unknown/missing associated types and missing methods; inherent associated bindings and conflicting bindings are rejected.
Associated concrete types register after trait definitions and before function signatures. Native normal registration and metadata-signature roots share that sequence.
Source interfaces include trait/owner/ordinal-associated-type tuples from compiled CSharp plans; semantic declaration fingerprints include resolved implementation facts.
Native function names and implementation metadata use one impl-header/associated-field extractor. Trait/owner sorting is separate from persisted key fields.
